svg.text: 交流・電磁誘導・静電気・電子の動きの向きは、水では正しく表せない。

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: AC, electromagnetic induction, static charge and electron motion are not represented by water.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: たとえは入口。細かい話は電気の言葉で考える。 / The analogy is an entry point; think electrically afterwards.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: 電圧は水圧、電流は流量、抵抗は流れにくさ。電力は1秒あたりのエネルギー

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: Voltage is pressure, current is flow, resistance is restriction, power is energy per second

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif
